title: Before You Use Claude Fable 5, Watch This
description:
Anthropic just dropped an official guide on getting the best results from Claude Fable 5, and the rules are nothing like previous models.

In this video, I break down the 3 core principles:
✅ Keep prompts short — less is more with Fable 5
✅ Tell it why, not just what — context unlocks better outputs
✅ Set clear guardrails — Fable 5 is autonomous, so boundaries matter

Comment "FABLE" and I'll send you the full official guide personally.
